prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Subhash bhai, Subhash I., Suresh bhai, Deepak bhai.
The chat covers 24/03/26, 7:30 pm to 24/03/26, 9:30 pm. It must have exactly 25 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
24/03/26, 8:30 pm - Subhash bhai: Deepak bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- F1: chat.txt:15 at 8:32 pm vs calls.csv row 4 at 20:29 differs by 3 min (tolerance 2)
text:
24/03/26, 7:30 pm - Suresh bhai: Haan bhai, aaj shaam ka kya hisaab hai?
24/03/26, 7:35 pm - Deepak bhai: Suresh bhai, abhi dukan pe hoon, thoda kaam baaki hai.
24/03/26, 7:40 pm - Subhash I.: Aaj UPI account me kuch payment miss ho rahi hai.
24/03/26, 7:45 pm - Subhash bhai: Subhash I., kaunsi payment check kar rahe ho?
24/03/26, 7:50 pm - Subhash I.: Wo 15,000 wali QR code scan payment.
24/03/26, 7:55 pm - Deepak bhai: Haan wo customer bol raha tha transfer ho gaya hai.
24/03/26, 8:00 pm - Suresh bhai: Screenshot maango usse pehle.
24/03/26, 8:05 pm - Subhash I.: Screenshot bhej diya hai usne, par bank statement me nahi aaya.
24/03/26, 8:10 pm - Subhash bhai: Main dekhta hoon system me login karke.
24/03/26, 8:15 pm - Deepak bhai: Bhai fake payment app ka scene toh nahi hai na?
24/03/26, 8:20 pm - Suresh bhai: Lagta toh wahi hai, aaj kal bohot chal raha hai ye.
24/03/26, 8:25 pm - Subhash I.: Ha, fraud lag raha hai ye poora case.
24/03/26, 8:30 pm - Subhash bhai: Deepak bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
24/03/26, 8:30 pm - Deepak bhai: Subhash bhai, phone par baat karo abhi call aaya tha.
24/03/26, 8:30 pm - Subhash bhai: Haan main call attend kar raha hoon.
24/03/26, 8:35 pm - Deepak bhai: Par ledger me entry match nahi hogi phir.
24/03/26, 8:40 pm - Subhash I.: Subhash bhai, tumne entry delete kyun karwayi?
24/03/26, 8:45 pm - Suresh bhai: Kya chal raha hai tum dono ke beech?
24/03/26, 8:50 pm - Subhash bhai: Kuch nahi, galat entry thi, system issue tha.
24/03/26, 8:55 pm - Deepak bhai: Main kisi ko nahi bataunga, par clear kar lo.
24/03/26, 9:00 pm - Suresh bhai: Subhash I., tum audit report kal subah check kar lena.
24/03/26, 9:08 pm - Subhash I.: Thik hai Suresh bhai, main kal bank me confirm karunga.
24/03/26, 9:15 pm - Subhash bhai: Kal subah dukan pe milte hain sab.
24/03/26, 9:22 pm - Deepak bhai: Ok bhai, main shop close kar raha hoon.
24/03/26, 9:30 pm - Suresh bhai: Good night sabko, kal baat karte hain.
